summary.key_insight: SAC achieved 2.32 points higher reward than PPO (1.51% improvement) with better stability (lower std dev variability). SAC is recommended for production.

primary_choice.rationale: Best reward (156.29), good stability, off-policy efficiency
primary_choice.deployment_strategy: Primary model for all pricing recommendations

secondary_choice.deployment_strategy: A/B test against SAC (10% traffic) to validate production performance

fallback.deployment_strategy: Fallback only if SAC/PPO unavailable (degraded mode)
